Benana is being pivoted (decided 2026-10-11) into "Mod Studio": user describes a mod → Claude Code builds a Paper plugin → deploys to a local Paper server → a Claude Code playtester drives a Mineflayer bot through an MCP server → finds bugs → fixes and retests.

Locked decisions: Paper plugins (Maven) not Fabric; Mineflayer bot with prismarine-viewer embedded in the Electron app; organic bugs plus a clearly labeled injected-bug fallback; reuse the existing Benana shell/runner/worktrees/retry flow; Claude Code for builder and playtester (Neatlogs Claude Code plugin gives tracing); hero demo mod = "launch sword" (golden sword launches mobs upward with particles). Solo developer, ~24h of build time.

**Why:** neatHack (https://neatlogs.com/hackathon) scores agent capability 30%, partner tools 25% (neatlogs, Entire, cfo.ai all mandatory), demo video 20%, public build log 15%, originality 10%. Submissions close 2026-10-12 23:55 IST.

**How to apply:** Prefer demo reliability and visible partner evidence over breadth. As of 2026-10-11 no partner (Neatlogs/Entire/cfo.ai) was set up yet; the Entire CLI was not installed.

Do NOT push to `main` on `Pratheek555/benana` without the user's explicit permission for that push. On 2026-10-11 the user revoked the earlier standing permission to push at milestones ("from now on do not push anything to main without my permission"). Committing locally is fine; ask before pushing. They post milestones on X as #neatHack build-log evidence.

Agent model mix: Opus 5.5 for the spec, builder and fixer agents; Sonnet 5.5 for the playtester (speed). Neatlogs Claude Code hooks are installed per project, only in Benana's generated mod repos, never globally. Installing the Entire CLI (Scoop) and `@neatlogs/claude-code` (npm -g) was approved.

**Why:** Commits dated during the event are judged evidence, and the demo video needs a fast loop; the user now wants to review before anything lands on `main`. The user doesn't want their personal Claude Code sessions traced.

**How to apply:** After a verified milestone, commit locally and ask whether to push; only push once they say yes. Never ask for secrets in chat; the user puts keys in `.env`, and commands source them without echoing. Related: [[neathack-mod-studio-pivot]].
